sequence_note: The full suite discovered its tests before the final additional native-GTK optional-submenu regression was added. The final 68-test focused run includes that case and the property-order fix. Build, preseed, shell, AppArmor and payload checks were repeated against the final source. Counts overlap and must not be added as unique tests.

limits: No unattended d-i boot, real hardware, or live Forky/systemd 261.2 session was available.

Python GI and Perl Moo/MooX were unavailable in the container; skipped or blocked dependency checks are not passes. Existing target package selections already include the relevant runtime dependencies.
The notification-center Python/GTK window was not driven against a real Mako session; native GtkBuilder tests use GTK3 C libraries, not Python GI.
AppArmor policy parsing is not a claim of successful kernel enforcement.

Full repository validation is not green: three failures also reproduced in the untouched baseline are preserved and explained; an additional bootstrap timing failure was seen in the baseline and an isolated run but passes in the final full suite.
The repository-wide audit provides syntax, lexical unit structure and inventory checks, not a proof that all existing code is defect-free.
